title: Calendar Filter – Course Deselection – SF Calendar – No Classes Checked – Class Section Hidden
description: BR-12 — State Transition Testing — Confirms that deselecting a course when no classes are checked causes the class filter section to completely disappear.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org\n- SF Mana Calendar filter panel is open
steps_actions:
1. In the SF Mana Calendar filter, select "Course A – Introduction to Math"
2. Do NOT check any class; deselect / clear "Course A" from the Course filter
3. Observe the filter panel
4. Observe the calendar
steps_result:
1. Course A selected; Class section appears with 3 classes unchecked
2. Course A is deselected
3. The Class section is no longer visible — the entire class list has been hidden
4. All lessons are shown (no active course filter, no class filter)
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Course Deselection – Class List Clear

title: Calendar Filter – Course Deselection – Classes Already Checked – All Checked Classes Also Cleared
description: BR-12 — State Transition Testing (boundary) — Confirms that when a course is deselected while classes are already checked, the class list is fully cleared including checked state — not just hidden with stale state preserved.
preconditions: - Feature flag Multiple_Classes_In_Lesson__c is set to TRUE\n- Course A has 3 classes; Group lessons G1–G4 exist in the current week\n- Logged in as HQ or CM Staff to the Salesforce org
steps_actions:
1. On SF Mana Calendar, select "Course A" in the Course filter
2. Check Class Alpha and Class Beta
3. Deselect "Course A" from the Course filter
4. Observe the filter panel
5. Observe the calendar
steps_result:
1. Class section appears with 3 classes unchecked
2. Both classes checked; calendar shows only Lesson G2 (has both)
3. Course A is deselected
4. Class section disappears; class filter state is fully cleared — no class checkboxes visible
5. All lessons are shown — no course filter and no class filter active
suite: lesson-management > lesson > course-class-filter > Course Deselection – Class List Clear
